note: All prompts are read-only by construction. This skill deploys to a live home lab; eval runs must never tag, push, open PRs, or mutate the cluster.

evals.name: diagnose-version-drift
evals.prompt: eve-ambient seems to be running an older version than eve and eve-tools in my cluster. What's going on there and what's the right way to fix it? Don't change anything yet, just tell me.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the drift concretely (eve-ambient v0.2.0 vs v0.2.4), explains why skew is dangerous (shared src/eve code), and prescribes a single release bumping all three together rather than bumping eve-ambient alone.
assertions: Names the actual drifted versions: eve-ambient on v0.2.0 vs eve and eve-tools on v0.2.4
Locates the pin in home-lab-infrastructure at kubernetes/apps/eve-ambient/overlays/homelab/kustomization.yaml
Explains why the skew is dangerous (the three images share src/eve code and the eve-tools HTTP contract)
Prescribes one release bumping all three images together, not an eve-ambient-only bump
Made no mutating change (no tag, commit, push, PR, or kubectl write)

evals.name: plan-full-release
evals.prompt: I just merged a fix to eve's main branch and I need it running in the home lab. Walk me through every step to get it deployed. Don't execute anything - I want to read the plan first.
evals.expected_output: Full plan: bump pyproject, tag eve-ai, wait for the 3-way GHCR matrix build, one PR bumping all three kustomize overlays in home-lab-infrastructure, ArgoCD auto-sync, verify running image tags.
assertions: States all three images (eve-ai, eve-tools, eve-ambient) build from one tag and must be bumped together
States the GHCR build fires only on pushing a v* git tag, not on merge to main
Includes bumping pyproject.toml to the release version
Says the infra change is a PR in home-lab-infrastructure updating all three overlay newTags
States ArgoCD auto-syncs on merge, so no manual deploy step is needed
Includes a verification step comparing running image tags against the release version
Made no mutating change (no tag, commit, push, PR, or kubectl write)

evals.name: check-sync-status
evals.prompt: Is eve fully in sync right now - repo, manifests and what's actually running? Read-only please.
evals.expected_output: Reports the version at every pin point (pyproject, git tag, 3 overlays, 3 live deployments) and flags that pyproject is 0.1.0 and eve-ambient is v0.2.0 while the rest are v0.2.4.
assertions: Reports the latest eve-ai git tag (v0.2.4)
Reports the newTag from all three kustomize overlays
Reports the live image tag of all three running deployments from the cluster
Concludes NOT in sync, flagging both eve-ambient v0.2.0 and the stale pyproject 0.1.0
Made no mutating change (no tag, commit, push, PR, or kubectl write)
